record.question: Which of the following statement is incorrect:
options: Penalty for illegal strike is one month imprisonment or with fine which may extend to fifty rupees or with both
Penalty for illegal lock-out is one month imprisonment or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees or with both
Penalty for giving financial aid to illegal strike and lock-outs are three months imprisonment or with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees or with both
Any person who instigate for any strike or lock-out which is illegal shall be punishable with imprisonment for six months or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees or with both
